§7.6 rule (b) (S483 q8-fu2) — `${ const c: string = w.replaceAll("x", w); }` inside `

5)>`: a replaceAll whose receiver and replacement are not literals proven to fit can pass the longest string (E-INDEX-OUT-OF-RANGE-RT) and the initializer runs before the test — E-FILE-SCOPE-INIT-IN-CONSTRUCT.
rationale: §7.6 rule (b) (S483): "An initializer there that can trap SHALL be E-FILE-SCOPE-INIT-IN-CONSTRUCT"; a `replaceAll` is a trap site unless its receiver and replacement are literals whose result provably fits (S483 q8-fu2, #2133 review MED-1 — before, neither half counted it and the page blanked). ruling:user-voice-scrml.md-S482-trapping-construct-init — owner: "yes, interim refusal now and the feature later".
